name: Cyberpunk RED sheet (unofficial)
summary: Unofficial Cyberpunk RED character sheet, in English: gauges, STATS and skills with their modifiers, skills sorted by category, weapons, cyberware by type with mother pieces and options, damage to the target with armour, three skins.
changelog: Modifiers: a STAT's counts wherever the STAT does, a skill's for that skill only. STAT boxes of one shape. Characters already filled in keep everything.
